scope.independent_helper_dependency: The adapter requires android-proc-permission-diagnostic-01's diagnostic-only verification_hygiene.py at SHA256 1fc2fb6f0b3bb7a505edc63277e0fe974a67ccf972753eec0da60386438c16f4. observed_failure_context.retained_failure: Android sampled emulator absence did not pass; retain outputs
observed_failure_context.inference_limit: The original receipt does not identify the denied procfs operation or that process's selected-UID classification. selected_uid is the completed selected-sample count, not a failing-process UID. The new nondumpable control must not be used to retrospectively invent either fact.
observed_failure_context.preservation: The failed full-D receipt and retained-output decision remain failures. A later bare-host sample cannot repair that post-emulator cleanup or establish combined qualification.

source_findings.admission: Exact workflow_dispatch/repository/continuation branch/workflow-ref/job/Linux-X64 context, numeric run/attempt, closed bounded input keys, default native selection with unused inputs empty, frozen source equal to GITHUB_SHA and GITHUB_WORKFLOW_SHA, local HEAD/branch/full history/clean checkout, Ubuntu24.04/x86_64 and approved ten-file control digest are required. Existing helper requires matching nonroot real/effective UID and exact SDK path hash/device/inode binding. Source/control/SDK proof is rechecked after observations and again before cleanup.
source_findings.control_manifest: The ten-file digest covers the existing workflow, adapter, hygiene implementation, workflow contract, three related test files, wrapper script/JAR/properties. Each file is read through a regular, nonredirected, size-bounded path with before/after metadata equality. Actual SHA rows are recomputed, not accepted from caller metadata.
source_findings.genuine_host_vs_controls: run() invokes the ordinary real /proc host audit once before fixtures. Each control is explicitly LIVE_LINUX_CONTROL_SYNTHETIC_ENUMERATION and exposes only owned symlinks to this observer and its direct child; reads still go to real procfs. Positive requires actual two-entry PASS/no errors/two sampled selected-UID records/no matches. Negative requires actual FAIL with exactly PermissionError, before_exe_readlink, selection=true and EACCES. CONTROL_PASS on that expected failure cannot produce overall PASS unless the independent host audit is PASS and both controls pass.
source_findings.ownership_signals_and_cleanup: Temporary fixture is exclusively created beneath an absolute nonredirected current-UID parent. Only a held Popen direct child is signaled; isolated fixed /usr/bin/python3 -I -B command, closed small environment, fixed ctypes PR_SET_DUMPABLE/PR_GET_DUMPABLE calls, nonroot check, bounded readiness and 12-second self alarm. No sudo/setuid/kernel-policy relaxation, emulator, process enumeration command, arbitrary PID kill or process group kill. EOF is ordinary retirement, with bounded wait/terminate/kill fallback on the same handle; timeout remains a failure. INT/TERM are recorded during cleanup and restored, never converted to successful control.
source_findings.fixture_retirement: Child wait/reaped receipt precedes fixture retirement. Exact fixture device/inode/UID/directory identity, expected child/self symlink names and exact targets are checked; unknown members or changed custody retain the fixture and fail. No recursive cleanup of /proc, shared SDK, global caches or other outputs. Next control requires previous child and fixture retirement.
source_findings.evidence_and_finalization: Observation is preserved before immediate Gradle stop; stop executes in finally even if observation preservation fails. Distinct observation/ownership/stop artifacts upload before cleanup. Finalizer requires the same source/control/task/SDK proof, successful immediate stop and both control-resource retirement receipts before calling unchanged generic hygiene.cleanup. Upload identity/digest, source and output ownership, a new unchanged real /proc absence audit and Gradle stop still gate deletion. A failed host observation remains nonzero even if a separate final cleanup sample later succeeds.
source_findings.privacy: Actual-host audit exposes bounded aggregate counts, closed error codes/diagnostic operation-selection-errno and SDK binding hashes, not arbitrary process PID/argv/environment/executable path. Only this task's synthetic child PID/readiness and fixture basename are recorded by the adapter; exception text/private paths are not serialized.
source_findings.workflow_isolation: One explicit linux-process-probe option; default full and existing five jobs remain. Only desktop-android runs in probe mode, on ubuntu-24.04 with 10-minute bound. Other desktop job bodies are byte-identical; iOS differs only by additionally excluding this probe. Existing Linux build/SDK/managed-device/artifact commands and finalizer bodies are unchanged except full-only if fences. No Store workflow changes, new matrix, private credentials, caching-as-runtime claims or publication route.
source_findings.regression_scope: Existing workflow contract gains a closed probe step/name/order/runner/timeout/input/artifact-path contract. Nine small adapter test methods cover input/source/control rejection, exact file hashes, expected-negative separation, readiness/timeout/interrupt retirement, wrong denial classification, unreaped/unknown fixtures, host failure and cleanup delegation. Two added workflow methods cover lane isolation and exact bindings/uploads. Existing hygiene controls are reused; no parallel diagnostic framework.

resolved_findings.issue: New adapter fixture class used actual Unix UID/signal/symlink operations without an explicit Linux applicability gate, unlike the established procfs fixture class; direct Windows test discovery could fail for an irrelevant platform.
resolved_findings.author_correction: Added @unittest.skipUnless(sys.platform == 'linux', 'Linux-only procfs/UID/symlink controls') to the new fixture class; no method, adapter, workflow or production-acceptance logic changed.
resolved_findings.independent_resolution: Decorator reopened and statically verified. The nine new fixtures explicitly skip non-Linux; this does not waive Linux execution or simulate a runtime pass.

execution_accounting.checks_actually_performed: Read-only Git/source/log inspection, standard-library hashing, four Python AST parses plus the literal child program's AST, static workflow/unchanged-lane comparisons. Final static assertion command exited0.
execution_accounting.inspection_correction: An initial reviewer-only assertion guessed12 top-level child AST statements; source inspection showed13. The counting assumption was corrected, not the program or evidence. This was not a project/native test failure.
execution_accounting.cleanup: No build/test cycle, child process fixture, SDK mutation, simulator, worker or bytecode output created by reviewer; no Gradle stop or cleanup command issued from this read-only review lane.

limits_and_next_actions: Approval is only for these five proposed byte-pinned files, with the separately reviewed diagnostic helper at the pinned hash. Root alone may adopt after the current frozen full-D collector/final stop completes.
Held drafts retain ROOT-relative imports/contracts. Root must use a complete bound overlay or reviewed adoption, not execute a partially staged draft against stale canonical dependencies.

Root still must execute focused Linux tests and the shared real nonroot control with exact adapter/helper hashes and an actually owned SDK/resource fixture; no fake GitHub environment or repository/global-SDK permission changes are needed.

A hosted diagnostic, if still justified after local controls, needs a newly frozen/committed source and fresh ten-file digest/request binding. This report neither dispatches nor approves an unseen request.
Positive/negative control expectations are unexecuted source logic in this review. No actual /proc failure location, errno or process classification is established here.

The sampling oracle remains bounded/non-atomic, selected-UID/bound-SDK/emulator-path-only, not task ownership, process termination, AVD retirement, continuous absence, app runtime or post-build reproduction.
No original A/B/C credit, combined-D pass, strict file-protection repair, physical-device, Store or owner/legal approval is supplied.
